jobs.title: Back of House Clerk - be the backbone of the operations
jobs.description: WHO WE NEED We are looking for ambitious talents who will become the shapers of the new reborn legendary hotel in one of the most prestigious alpine resorts in the world. Are you expecting more than a job? Then let’s GRACE together from Winter 2026/27! WHAT WILL YOU DO? Maintain high standards of cleanliness, organization, and tidiness across all Back of House areas Provide operational support to all departments as required, contributing to the smooth day-to-day running of the operation Assist with the setup, execution, and breakdown of events, ensuring all areas and equipment are prepared and cleared efficiently Load and unload catering vans, ensuring all required equipment, supplies, and materials are prepared, transported, and properly stored Support the setup and breakdown of catering locations during events, ensuring materials and equipment are handled safely and efficiently Assist the Maintenance team with operational tasks during periods of increased workload Take ownership of assigned operational tasks and proactively support the wider team whenever required Assist with inventory management, including organizing, monitoring, and storing stock and operational materials YOUR +sides Your smile is infectious and you treat people as if they were your best friends You go the extra mile to make the best first and last impression You are a team player and enjoy helping others You have a strong interest in hospitality and you are eager to learn You can multi-task and work in a fast-paced environment You lead with example and pride You love to try new things and go a different path You like to push your comfort zone to the edge Guests always come first to you WHAT’S IN FOR YOU AT GRACE? Become a pioneer for the first hotel opening to happen in 100 years in St. Moritz in this segment Fun, collaborative and caring environment where people are put first Grace House for talents Hands-on learning and training opportunities F&B discounts & sporting activities free of charge Cool uniform from an international luxury clothing brand If needed state-of-the-art accommodation And much, much more… ONE MORE THING 43.5 hours working week according to L-GAV 35 days of holiday according to L-GAV 13 monthly salaries according to L-GAV Wage above L-GAV minimum

descriptionByLocale.it: DI CHI abbiamo BISOGNO Siamo alla ricerca di talenti ambiziosi che diventeranno i modellatori della rinascita del leggendario hotel in una delle località alpine più prestigiose al mondo. Ti aspetti più di un lavoro? Allora festeggiamo insieme dall'inverno 2026/27! COSA FARAI? Mantenere elevati standard di pulizia, organizzazione e ordine in tutte le aree del retro della casa Fornire supporto operativo a tutti i reparti come richiesto, contribuendo al regolare funzionamento quotidiano dell'operazione Assistere con la configurazione, l'esecuzione e la ripartizione degli eventi, assicurando che tutte le aree e le attrezzature siano preparate e sgomberate in modo efficiente Caricare e scaricare i furgoni di catering, assicurando che tutte le attrezzature, le forniture e i materiali necessari siano preparati, trasportati e adeguatamente conservati Supportare la configurazione e la ripartizione dei luoghi di catering durante gli eventi, garantire che materiali e attrezzature siano gestiti in modo sicuro ed efficiente Assistere il team di manutenzione con attività operative durante i periodi di maggiore carico di lavoro Assumersi la responsabilità delle attività operative assegnate e supportare in modo proattivo il team più ampio ogni volta che è necessario Assistere nella gestione dell'inventario, tra cui l'organizzazione, IL monitoraggio e lo stoccaggio di scorte e materiali operativi sui lati + Il tuo sorriso è contagioso e tratti le persone come se fossero i tuoi migliori amici Fai il possibile per dare la migliore prima e ultima impressione Sei un giocatore di squadra e ti diverti ad aiutare gli altri Hai un forte interesse nell'ospitalità e sei desideroso di imparare Puoi svolgere più compiti e lavorare
descriptionByLocale.de:
WEN wir BRAUCHEN Wir suchen ambitionierte Talente, die zu Gestaltern des neugeborenen legendären Hotels in einem der renommiertesten Alpenresorts der Welt werden. Erwarten Sie mehr als einen Job? Dann lasst uns ab Winter 2026/27 gemeinsam ZIEREN! WAS WERDEN SIE TUN? Aufrechterhaltung hoher Standards in Bezug auf Sauberkeit, Organisation und Ordnung in allen Back-of-House-Bereichen Stellen Sie bei Bedarf allen Abteilungen operative Unterstützung zur Verfügung und tragen Sie so zum reibungslosen täglichen Ablauf des Betriebs bei. Helfen Sie bei der Einrichtung, Durchführung und Abwicklung von Veranstaltungen, stellen Sie sicher, dass alle Bereiche und Geräte effizient vorbereitet und geräumt werden. Be- und Entladen Sie Catering-Vans, stellen Sie sicher, dass alle erforderlichen Geräte, Vorräte und Materialien vorbereitet, transportiert und ordnungsgemäß gelagert werden. Unterstützen Sie die Einrichtung und Abwicklung von Catering-Standorten während Veranstaltungen. Sicherstellen, dass Materialien und Ausrüstung sicher und effizient gehandhabt werden Unterstützen Sie das Wartungsteam bei operativen 
• Aufgaben in Zeiten erhöhter Arbeitsbelastung Übernehmen Sie die Verantwortung für zugewiesene operative 
• Aufgaben und unterstützen Sie das breitere Team bei Bedarf proaktiv Unterstützen Sie bei der Bestandsverwaltung, einschließlich der Organisation, Überwachung und Lagerung von Lager- und Betriebsmaterialien IHRE +Seiten Ihr Lächeln ist ansteckend und Sie behandeln Menschen, als wären sie Ihre besten Freunde Sie gehen die extra Meile, um den besten ersten und letzten Eindruck zu machen Sie sind ein Teamplayer und genießen es, anderen zu helfen Sie haben ein starkes Interesse in der Gastfreundschaft und Sie sind begierig zu lernen Sie können Multitasking und Arbeit
descriptionByLocale.fr: QUI avons-nous BESOIN Nous recherchons des talents ambitieux qui deviendront les créateurs du nouvel hôtel légendaire renaissant dans l'une des stations alpines les plus prestigieuses du monde. Vous attendez plus qu'un emploi ? Alors faisons la GRÂCE ensemble à partir de l'hiver 2026/27 ! QUE FEREZ-VOUS ? Maintenir des normes élevées de propreté, d'organisation et de propreté dans toutes les zones de l'arrière de la maison Fournir un soutien opérationnel à tous les départements, au besoin, en contribuant au bon fonctionnement quotidien de l'opération Aider à la configuration, à l'exécution et à la répartition des événements, en veillant à ce que toutes les zones et tous les équipements soient préparés et nettoyés efficacement Charger et décharger les fourgonnettes de restauration, en veillant à ce que tous les équipements, fournitures et matériaux nécessaires soient préparés, transportés et correctement stockés Soutenir la configuration et la répartition des lieux de restauration pendant les événements, s'assurer que les matériaux et l'équipement sont manipulés de manière sûre et efficace Aider l'équipe de maintenance à effectuer des tâches opérationnelles pendant les périodes de charge de travail accrue S'approprier les tâches opérationnelles assignées et soutenir de manière proactive l'équipe au sens large chaque fois que nécessaire Aider à la gestion des stocks, y compris l'organisation, le suivi et le stockage des stocks et des matériaux opérationnels VOS +côtés Votre sourire est contagieux et vous traitez les gens comme s'ils étaient vos meilleurs amis Vous faites un effort supplémentaire pour faire la meilleure première et dernière impression Vous êtes un joueur d'équipe et aimez aider les autres Vous avez un fort intérêt dans l'hospitalité et vous êtes impatient d'apprendre Vous pouvez effectuer plusieurs tâches et travailler

jobs.title: Event Manager- be the spark behind every celebration
jobs.description: WHO WE NEED We are looking for ambitious talents who will become the shapers of the new reborn legendary hotel in one of the most prestigious alpine resorts in the world. Are you expecting more than a job? Then let’s GRACE together! WHAT WILL YOU DO? ● Proactively identify, approach and win new groups, weddings, conferences, incentives, banquets and private-event business – you hunt for business, not just process enquiries ● Lead client consultations end-to-end: understand the brief, shape the concept, build the proposal, quote it and negotiate terms ● Negotiate contracts and rates directly with clients, agents and corporate bookers, and close the deal – you carry your own pipeline and revenue targets ● Build and manage event budgets, control costs and margins, and report on conversion and revenue performance ● Partner closely with F&B leadership and the kitchen on menus, service concepts and pricing so every proposal is commercially and operationally sound before it goes to the client ● Be the single point of contact for the client from contract signature through planning, execution and post-event follow-up ● Coordinate and brief all departments involved in delivery – F&B, kitchen, housekeeping, engineering, spa, security – and external vendors (decorators, technicians, entertainment) ● Act as on-site host during groups and events, resolving issues in real time and protecting the guest experience and the hotel's reputation ● Plan and dispatch off-site and private catering – private residences, private jets, transfers and boutique locations – in coordination with F&B ● Keep the department's point-of-sale, offer templates and booking processes current, both on-site and for secondary locations ● Work with marketing on positioning, packages and promotion of the groups & events offering to attract new clientele ● Ensure every event complies with health, safety and legal requirements, and uphold GRACE's quality standards throughout ● Continuously refine SOPs and processes for the department – good is never enough YOUR +sides Your smile is infectious and you treat people as if they were your best friends You go the extra mile to make the best first and last impression You are a team player and enjoy helping others You have a strong interest in hospitality and you are eager to learn You can multi-task and work in a fast-paced environment You lead with example and pride You love to try new things and go a different path You like to push your comfort zone to the edge Guests always come first to you Languages German, English and Italian are one of your stenght WHAT’S IN FOR YOU AT GRACE? Become a pioneer for the first hotel opening to happen in 100 years in St. Moritz in this segment Fun, collaborative and caring environment where people are put first Grace House for talents Hands-on learning and training opportunities F&B discounts & sporting activities free of charge Cool uniform from an international luxury clothing brand If needed state-of-the-art accommodation And much, much more… ONE MORE THING 43.5 hours working week according to L-GAV 35 days of holiday according to L-GAV 13 monthly salaries according to L-GAV Wage above L-GAV minimum

descriptionByLocale.fr: QUI avons-nous BESOIN Nous recherchons des talents ambitieux qui deviendront les créateurs du nouvel hôtel légendaire renaissant dans l'une des stations alpines les plus prestigieuses du monde. Vous attendez plus qu'un emploi ? Alors, faisons la GRÂCE ensemble ! QUE FEREZ-VOUS ?
